hero.desc: We reserve the right to modify or replace these Terms of Use at any time. Material changes will be announced on the site or via email. Updated terms require manual review and explicit consent.

terms.paragraph: By accessing YokaiVerse, you agree to be bound by these terms. Please read them carefully before creating an account.

AccessAndRegistration.paragraph_1: Access to YokaiVerse is subject to these terms. We reserve the right to modify services or terminate accounts that violate our community standards.

ThirdPartyAIIntegrationAndTranslations.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse uses a hybrid translation system consisting of human-verified and automated AI operations. Users can integrate their own AI API keys for real-time translation.
ThirdPartyAIIntegrationAndTranslations.paragraph_2: The workflow prioritizes human-verified translations, followed by the user's AI keys. We do not guarantee the accuracy of AI-generated content.

Advertisements.paragraph_1: Instead of ads based on individual user profiles or behavioral tracking, we use non-personalized, contextual advertisements based on the content type.

ServiceModification.paragraph_1: We reserve the right to add or remove support for specific Third-Party AI providers at any time without prior notice to the user.

AmendmentsAndModifications.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse reserves the right to modify or renew these Terms at any time at its sole discretion. Users will be notified of significant changes 7 to 30 days in advance via their registered email or in-site announcements. By registering and continuing to use the service, you give legal consent to these terms. If you do not agree to the updated terms, you must stop using the platform.

UserIdentity.paragraph_1: Each user is assigned a unique @username. When an account is deleted, that @username is retired to prevent identity theft and will never be made available for registration again.

AgeRestrictions.paragraph_1: By registering, you declare that you are at least 16 years of age. Users under the age of 18 are prohibited from participating in Forums or Comments.

ProhibitedConductAndEnforcement.paragraph_1: If a user is found to be violating age limits, engaging in harassment, or attempting to breach security, their IP address will be permanently blacklisted. New accounts created from a blacklisted IP will be automatically closed. Users are solely responsible for their actions; in the event of illegal activities, YokaiVerse will cooperate fully with local law enforcement by providing all available logs and behavioral data without delay.

DataIntegrityAndUserResponsibility_ALT.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse uses HttpOnly technology for critical keys to prevent access by browser scripts. However, Stage 2 preferences such as themes and settings are stored in Local Storage and are accessible via the console. Users are strictly warned not to execute third-party code in the browser console (Self-XSS). YokaiVerse is not responsible for data theft or account breaches resulting from user-initiated code execution.

MandatoryParentalControl.paragraph_1: For users between 16 and 18 years of age, linking the account to a verified Parent/Guardian account is mandatory. Parents have comprehensive oversight authority, including screen time management, content filtering by tag or genre, and full visibility of watch history.
MandatoryParentalControl.paragraph_2: The parent account holds administrative authority, meaning the minor cannot alter their birth year or sensitive settings without authorization. Parents can also delete the minor's account remotely at any time. Upon turning 18, these restrictions are automatically disabled.

ParentalConnectionMechanism_ALT.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse uses HttpOnly technology for critical keys to prevent access by browser scripts. However, Stage 2 preferences such as themes and settings are stored in Local Storage and are accessible via the console. Users are strictly warned not to execute third-party code in the browser console (Self-XSS). YokaiVerse is not responsible for data theft or account breaches resulting from user-initiated code execution.

GoverningLawAndDisputeResolution.paragraph_1: The connection between accounts is established using secure, local-based authentication. This is done via QR Sync, where the parent scans a code on the minor's device, or via a manually entered 10-character alphanumeric code. This ensures authorization occurs through direct interaction, protecting our zero-knowledge security protocols.

ConflictOfLaws.header: Conflict of Laws and Global Compliance
ConflictOfLaws.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse is developed and hosted in Turkey; data processing activities are strictly subject to the KVKK Law No. 6698. While respecting global privacy principles, YokaiVerse will not comply with foreign regulations that conflict with mandatory provisions of Turkish Law. In the event of a legal dispute, the laws of the Republic of Turkey shall apply.

privacy.paragraph: YokaiVerse adopts a "Privacy-by-Design" architecture as its core operational philosophy. We believe digital privacy is a fundamental right, not an optional feature; thus, our entire infrastructure is built to ensure your sensitive user data remains solely under your control through advanced encryption and minimalist data collection practices.

encryption.paragraph_1: Our commitment to security begins at the source. All personal data is encrypted locally on your device before reaching our infrastructure. YokaiVerse servers use a Zero-Knowledge Storage model, hosting only ciphertext for which we do not possess the decryption keys. This ensures that neither our staff nor any third party can access or read your private information in plain text under any circumstances.

dataCollection.header: Data Collection, Usage, and Algorithmic Privacy
dataCollection.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse strictly limits data collection to what is necessary for platform integrity. We maintain only mandatory security logs, including IP addresses and login timestamps, for fraud prevention and security auditing. Diagnostic and error reports are disabled by default, though users may manually enable them to help us resolve technical issues. Additionally, while we record in-site actions to improve your navigation experience, this algorithmic tracking is entirely optional and can be turned off at any time in your account settings.

APIKeys.header: Secure Use of Third-Party API Keys
APIKeys.paragraph_1: When you integrate your own AI provider keys (such as OpenAI or Gemini), YokaiVerse applies the same rigorous encryption protocols to this data as it does to personal information. We act as a secure bridge; we do not log the content of requests sent to your AI providers, and we do not store these keys in a format accessible by our internal systems.

retention.header: Data Retention, Erasure Cycles, and Permanent Deletion
retention.paragraph_1: We enforce a strict "right to be forgotten" policy. Upon a user's request to delete their account, a 15-day period is initiated during which all encrypted personal information and metadata are permanently and irreversibly destroyed. For active accounts, we run a 30-day purge cycle where non-essential behavioral data and temporary security logs are automatically deleted. Once these periods expire, data recovery is technically impossible as both the encrypted data and associated keys are removed from our infrastructure.

advertising.paragraph_1: YokaiVerse maintains a strict policy against selling user data. To support the platform, we may share non-identifiable, aggregated information with advertising partners. These ads are entirely contextual; meaning they are served solely based on the content currently being viewed rather than individual tracking or behavioral profiling.

minorSafety.paragraph_1: For users under the age of 18, YokaiVerse enforces a transparent safety framework. When a Parental Control link is activated, certain usage data, including watch history and search terms, will be accessible by the linked Parent/Guardian account. By selecting the minor account, the user and their legal guardian consent to this visibility, designed to ensure a safe digital environment for young audiences.

mandatoryConsent.paragraph_1: To ensure our users are always informed, any update to this Privacy Policy will trigger an automatic reset of all consent statuses. Upon your first login following an update, you will be required to review the revised terms. You will have the choice to accept the new policy to continue service or reject the changes; if rejected, the 15-day permanent erasure process for your account and all associated data will be initiated immediately.

BYOKResponsibility.header: International Data Transfers and BYOK Responsibility
BYOKResponsibility.paragraph_1: Content translations via our "Bring Your Own Key" (BYOK) feature are processed by third-party AI providers in accordance with your specific API configurations. By providing these keys, you acknowledge that your data may be processed in jurisdictions outside your country of residence. YokaiVerse acts solely as a technical intermediary and assumes no responsibility for the data handling practices of these external providers.

Self-XSS.paragraph_1: Content translations via our "Bring Your Own Key" (BYOK) feature are processed by third-party AI providers in accordance with your specific API configurations. By providing these keys, you acknowledge that your data may be processed in jurisdictions outside your country of residence. YokaiVerse acts solely as a technical intermediary and assumes no responsibility for the data handling practices of these external providers.

KVKK.header: KVKK Compliance and Data Subject Rights
KVKK.paragraph_1: As a Turkey-based project, YokaiVerse is exclusively subject to the provisions of the Law on Protection of Personal Data No. 6698 (KVKK). Regardless of your physical location, you acknowledge that your data is processed in accordance with Turkish legal standards. Users possess the rights to information, rectification, and erasure specified in Article 11 of the KVKK. Please note that due to our E2EE architecture, we cannot provide "plain text" versions of your data in response to access requests, as we do not possess the means to decrypt it.

lawEnforcement.header: Law Enforcement Cooperation and Legal Obligation
lawEnforcement.paragraph_1: In the event of a valid legal ruling concerning cybercrime or fraud, YokaiVerse will provide available security logs (IP addresses and timestamps) to the judicial and administrative authorities of the Republic of Turkey. Our capacity to cooperate is limited by our 30-day purge cycle; we can only provide logs that exist at the time of the request. While behavioral data is rapidly erased, basic security logs may be retained longer if required by local law or needed to investigate major security breaches.

storage.paragraph_1: We utilize a two-tier storage system designed to balance security with performance without using marketing cookies. Stage 1 consists of Security-Critical Cookies (Session Tokens, Encryption Keys, and API Keys), which are encrypted to prevent XSS attacks and protected by HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict flags. Stage 2 retains non-sensitive preferences like Dark Mode settings, video player configurations, and UI layouts in Local Storage to offer a seamless and personalized experience on every visit.

dataBreach.header: Data Breach Notification and Global Standards
dataBreach.paragraph_1: In the event of a security breach, YokaiVerse undertakes to notify affected users and relevant data protection authorities within the timeframes prescribed by local and international regulations. While bound by the KVKK, we respect the core principles of the GDPR (EU) and CCPA/CPRA (US) by offering data portability and erasure rights to users worldwide, ensuring our Turkey-based legal foundation never compromises our international community's security.
